summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests JNJ-95437446, alone or with amivantamab in some participants, in people with advanced-stage solid tumors. The route, dose, and schedule of JNJ-95437446 are not stated in the record. The study aims to find recommended phase 2 doses (RP2Ds) and to evaluate the safety of those doses.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa JNJ-95437446, solo o junto con amivantamab en algunos participantes, en personas con tumores sólidos en etapa avanzada. La vía, la dosis y el calendario de JNJ-95437446 no se indican en el registro. El estudio busca determinar las dosis recomendadas para fase 2 (RP2D) y evaluar la seguridad de esas dosis.
who_for: Diagnosed with unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic NSCLC, colorectal carcinoma, or head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
NSCLC adenocarcinoma and colorectal cancer need local EGFR or KRAS/NRAS/BRAF mutation testing
Measurable or evaluable disease (Part 2 requires at least one RECIST v1.1 measurable lesion)
ECOG performance status 0 to 1 and adequate blood, kidney, and liver function
not_for: Prior interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis that needed systemic steroids
Toxicity from prior cancer therapy not resolved to Grade 1 or lower
Clinically significant active infection needing systemic treatment within 7 days before first dose
Clinically significant cardiovascular disease within 6 months before consent
Second malignancy likely to interfere with safety or efficacy endpoints
